title: groundwork skill frontmatter
description: Schema for the YAML frontmatter at the top of every skill markdown file.

id.description: kebab-case identifier; must match the filename (without extension).

phase.description: Development phase this skill applies to. Must match the parent directory under skills/.

description.description: One sentence: what this skill does and when to invoke it.

trigger.description: Agent-readable: the scenario or signal that should cause this skill to activate.

entry_criteria.description: Conditions that must be true before starting this skill.

exit_criteria.description: Conditions that must be true when this skill is complete.

items.description: id of a principle file this skill draws on.

principles.description: Optional list of principle ids this skill references.

time_box.description: Optional expected human+agent time investment (e.g., '30-60 minutes').
